description.value: The Merritt Library is part of the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library system and occupies a purpose-built 2001 building on the site of the town's historic railyard, with architecture inspired by the old CP Rail station. A standout feature is the working model railway that circles near the ceiling — staff will run it on request. The library offers free Wi-Fi and public computers, and is fully wheelchair accessible, making it a useful indoor stop for touring cyclists passing through the Nicola Valley.

address.value: 1691 Garcia Street, Box 1510, Merritt, BC V1K 1B8

No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The library is confirmed open with named branch staff and regular hours listed on the website.
